义项: 名词 支撑建筑的立柱（massive sandstone pillars 巨大的砂岩柱）
名词 (引申义) 支柱、中坚（a pillar of the community）

例句.英文: At five-thirty the old Panhandle bridge, supported by massive sandstone pillars, stalwart, as when erected fifty years before to serve a generation now passed behind the portals of life, had become a spectral outline against the sky.
例句.中文: 五点半时，那座由巨大砂岩柱支撑的老潘汉德尔桥依旧如五十年前初建时那般坚固，在天空下只剩一道幽灵般的轮廓——它当年是为一代人而建，而那一代人如今已跨过生命之门。

例句.英文: He gestured to the lamassus [sculptures] and pillars surrounding us.
例句.中文: 他指了指我们四周的拉玛苏（神兽雕像）与石柱。

义项: 名词 水流、风力对地表或结构的磨蚀（wave erosion 波浪侵蚀）
名词 (引申义) （权利、价值）逐渐削弱；动词 erode

例句.英文: Adelaide, Australia, has installed engineered structures along 53% of its shoreline to protect infrastructure from wave erosion and other hazards, a practice known as shoreline hardening.
例句.中文: 澳大利亚阿德莱德在 53% 的海岸线上修建了工程结构，以保护基础设施免受波浪侵蚀及其它危害，这种做法被称为海岸硬化。

例句.英文: For example, the tree roots would have greatly reduced soil erosion, and the accumulated twigs the trees shed likely created new habitats for animal life.
例句.中文: 例如，树木根系本可大幅减少土壤侵蚀，落下的枯枝也本可能为动物创造新的栖息地。

义项: 形容词 从别处衍生而来、缺乏原创的（entirely derivative of 完全从…派生）
[辨析] 艺术评论中含贬义「模仿他人的」；金融语境指「衍生品」

例句.英文: Mimesis is typically translated as “imitation” in modern editions of ancient Greek texts, but scholar Stephen Halliwell warns that this is overly reductive: “imitation” implies that art merely copies—and is thus by definition entirely derivative of—a reality that exists outside and prior to the work of art, and translating “mimesis” thusly obscures the multifaceted ways in which the ancient Greeks understood the relationship between art and reality.
例句.中文: 「摹仿」在现代校本的希腊文古籍中通常译为 imitation，但学者 Stephen Halliwell 提醒说，这过于简化：「模仿」暗示艺术只是复制，因而在定义上完全派生自作品之外、先于作品存在的现实；这样翻译会遮蔽古希腊人理解艺术与现实关系时的多重面向。

例句.英文: Dong Liu et al. investigated the fracture toughness (both the initiation and propagation toughness) of the HEA CrMnFeCoNi and its MEA derivative CrCoNi and concluded that the alloys’ toughness performance differs from that of most HEAs and MEAs.

义项: 名词 引发情感或意义上的应和（adds powerful resonance 增添强烈的共鸣）
名词 物理共振；形容词 resonant 引起共鸣的

例句.英文: Her approach adds powerful resonance to films that explore the highly personal experiences of place and home, and often the difficult decision to stay or leave.
例句.中文: 她的处理方式为那些探讨地方与家园的切身经验、以及「留下还是离开」这一艰难抉择的影片，增添了强烈的共鸣。

例句.英文: It is the link of shared humanity with the artists across so many centuries that gives the Lascaux Cave paintings such resonance.
例句.中文: 正是与跨越许多世纪的艺术家之间共享的人性纽带，赋予了拉斯科洞穴壁画如此深长的共鸣。

义项: 名词 修士聚居修行的场所（a monastery near his manor 他庄园附近的修道院）
[辨析] 与 priory（小修道院）、abbey（大修道院）层级不同

例句.英文: Most infamously, he participated in what was essentially a private war against Sempringham Priory, a monastery near his manor, even making off with 500 pounds' worth of monastery property during a raid.
例句.中文: 最为人诟病的是，他参与了一场实质上针对森普林厄姆小修道院的私战——那是他庄园附近的一座修道院——甚至在一次袭击中掠走了价值 500 英镑的修道院财产。

义项: 形容词 强大到令人不敢轻慢的（his formidable technique 他令人叹服的技术）
[辨析] 既可形容对手「难对付」，也可形容能力「高超得令人敬畏」

例句.英文: Although he is indebted to the European tradition of figurative painting, with its proportionality of human form and depth between foreground and background, Anishinaabe painter Daniel Ashkewe uses his formidable technique to portray—and thereby ensure the transmission of—cultural traditions predating the European colonization of the lands of his tribe.
例句.中文: 尽管他受惠于欧洲具象绘画传统——那种讲究人体比例与前景背景纵深感的传统——阿尼什纳贝画家 Daniel Ashkewe 却以令人叹服的技术描绘了早于欧洲殖民其部族土地的种种文化传统，并借此确保它们得以传承。

义项: 名词 因罕见、陌生而引人兴趣的特质（interested in the novelty of the ship 对这艘船的新奇感兴趣）
名词 (引申义) 新奇的事物；形容词 novel 新颖的

例句.英文: Adam, seeing that the old man was interested in the novelty of the ship, suggested that he should stay the night on board, and that he would himself be ready to start at any hour and go anywhere that the other suggested.
例句.中文: 亚当见老人对这艘船的新奇之处颇感兴趣，便提议他在船上过夜，并说自己随时都准备出发，去对方想去的任何地方。

例句.英文: After you have stayed a week and the bloom of novelty has rubbed off you wonder if you can accommodate yourself to the peculiar conditions.
例句.中文: 住满一周、新奇的光泽磨掉之后，你就会开始怀疑自己能否适应这里的种种特殊境况。

义项: 形容词 认真而真诚的（very earnestly wish 恳切地希望）
[辨析] 与 Ernest（人名）同音；in earnest 认真地

例句.英文: For instance, Perry contends that some of Waugh’s earliest works, notably his biography of artist Dante Gabriel Rossetti, exhibit the earnest romanticism that would characterize Waugh’s later fiction.
例句.中文: 例如，Perry 主张：Waugh 最早的一些作品——尤其是他为画家 Dante Gabriel Rossetti 所作的传记——已展现出那种日后成为其小说特征的真挚浪漫主义。

义项: 动词 以力量制止、使无法发展（suppress domestic production 压制国内生产）
动词 (引申义) 抑制（情绪、免疫反应）；名词 suppression

例句.英文: Eliminating tariffs can lead to an influx of cheaper imported goods, lowering prices; in a place where domestic production is relatively expensive, this influx can suppress domestic production, as the country’s consumers favor more cheaply produced imported goods over domestically produced ones.
例句.中文: 这种大量涌入会压制国内生产，因为该国消费者更青睐价格更低的进口商品，而非本国产品。

例句.英文: As observed in a 2011 study by Emilio García-Robledo and Alfonso Corzo, macroalgal proliferation may have a suppressive effect on the abundance of cyanobacteria and other microphytobenthos (MPB)—chlorophyll-producing microbes inhabiting marine sediment—in part by reducing the amount of sunlight available to MPB.

义项: 名词 交通、通道堵塞（traffic congestion 交通拥堵）
名词 (引申义) 充血的；动词 congest 使堵塞

例句.英文: In a college course on urban affairs, a student asserts that traffic congestion in the United States increased between 1990 and 2000 mostly in and around very large cities such as Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
例句.中文: 在一门城市事务课程中，一名学生断言，1990 至 2000 年间，美国的交通拥堵主要发生在费城等特大城市及其周边。

例句.英文: In response to this challenge and others, such as the increasing congestion of roadways, delivery companies are continually looking for ways to make last-mile delivery more efficient.
例句.中文: 为应对这一挑战及道路日益拥堵等其他难题，快递公司不断寻找让末端配送更高效的办法。

义项: 名词 覆盖物、遮蔽之物（swathed in some soft veil 裹在一层轻柔的面纱里）
动词 (引申义) 遮掩（veiled criticism 含蓄的批评）

例句.英文: And like a spirit, swathed in some soft veil,Steals twilight and its shadow's o'er the swale.
例句.中文: 荒僻的潟湖里，野稻丛中，蜥蜴以单调的声调嘶鸣。归巢的大雁寻觅着可栖身之处，那里芦苇生长、渗水的苔藓附着。迟归的鹤振着沉重的翅膀、懒懒地飞，随夜色临近而滑入寂静。而黄昏像个幽灵，裹在一层轻柔的面纱里，携着它的影子悄悄爬过那片低洼的草地。莎草静卧，雾气漫起，浓重、灰白而潮湿，沼泽已入眠。

义项: 名词 某种事物开始盛行的时点（the advent of online streaming 在线流媒体的出现）
[辨析] 比 appearance 更强调「划时代的到来」；Advent 大写指基督降临节

例句.英文: The advent of online streaming has led many music listeners to drift away from ownership of music (through downloads or through physical media such as compact discs) in favor of the streaming services You Tube Music and Accu Radio, among others.
例句.中文: 在线流媒体的出现，使许多音乐听众不再追求「拥有」音乐（通过下载或光盘等实体媒介），转而使用 YouTube Music、Accu Radio 等流媒体服务。

义项: 形容词 色彩明亮强烈的（vibrantly blue head plumage 亮蓝色的头部羽毛）
形容词 (引申义) （城市、文化）生机勃勃的；名词 vibrancy

例句.英文: As juveniles, all white-necked jacobin hummingbirds display vibrantly blue head plumage; when they enter adulthood, males retain these blue feathers and most females molt to a drab green hue.
例句.中文: 所有白颈雅各宾蜂鸟在幼年时都长着亮蓝色的头部羽毛；进入成年后，雄性保留这些蓝色羽毛，而多数雌性则换羽为暗哑的绿色。

例句.英文: Chemists investigating the properties of coal tar in the mid-nineteenth century discovered compounds that led to the creation of vibrant artificial colorants.
例句.中文: 十九世纪中叶研究煤焦油性质的化学家发现了一些化合物，催生了鲜艳的人工色素。

义项: 名词 为推动社会或政治变革而采取的行动（political activism 政治行动主义）
[构词] active 积极的 → activism；environmental activism 环保行动

例句.英文: Imani Jacqueline Brown is an artist who blends scientific research, political activism, and various media in her work.
例句.中文: 伊玛尼·杰奎琳·布朗是一位艺术家，她的创作融合了科学研究、政治行动主义与多种媒介。

义项: 名词 事物本身存在的不足（these defects are partly remediable 这些缺陷部分可补救）
[辨析] 与 flaw 近义；动词 defect 意为「叛逃」，读音变为 /dɪˈfekt/

例句.英文: This information is necessary so that the electrician can begin figuring out whether the continued outage is caused by a defective device or simply by too many devices running at the same time.
例句.中文: 这些缺陷部分可以补救，甚至并不构成对字面真实的绝对违背。

例句.英文: A defect density, customer satisfaction; and B defect density, customer satisfaction and, C defect density, customer satisfaction, and D defect density; customer satisfaction, and Located in western Germany, Eifel National Park is a Dark Sky Park, a type of natural area recognized by DarkSky International.

义项: 名词 产生预期效果的能力（test the efficacy of the model 检验模型的效力）
[辨析] 与 efficiency（效率）不同：efficacy 问「有没有用」，efficiency 问「省不省」

例句.英文: Researchers used anonymized location data from the US and Côte d’Ivoire to document people’s daily patterns of mobility, using these results to test the efficacy of the researchers’ predictive computer model.
例句.中文: 研究者使用来自美国与科特迪瓦的匿名位置数据，记录人们日常的出行模式，并用这些结果检验其预测性计算机模型的效力。

例句.英文: The workshop advised mariners to avoid orcas pending further testing of the efficacy of TAST, a harmless acoustic deterrent.
例句.中文: 研讨会建议船员在进一步验证无害声学威慑装置 TAST 的效力之前，避让虎鲸。

义项: 形容词 与剧场、舞台演出相关的（theatrical costume design 戏剧服装设计）
形容词 (引申义) 夸张做作的（a theatrical gesture）

例句.英文: In a research paper about theatrical costume design, a student argues that costume designers for modern productions of Shakespeare's A Midsummer Night's Dream (set in ancient Greece) sometimes include such elements unintentionally.
例句.中文: 在一篇关于戏剧服装设计的论文中，一名学生主张，为莎士比亚《仲夏夜之梦》（背景设定在古希腊）的现代演出设计服装的设计师，有时会无意间纳入这类元素。

义项: 动词 使（资产、船只）困住无法脱身（the potential for stranding 资产搁浅的可能性）
名词 (引申义) 股、缕；（论述的）一条线索

例句.英文: The significance to investors of the potential for stranding is evident, and companies ought to disclose such risks to them, but it is no less important to ensure that when unsustainable companies involved in petroleum distribution cease operations, those companies' employees are assisted in their transitions to other jobs.
例句.中文: 资产搁浅的可能性对投资者的重要性显而易见，企业应当向他们披露此类风险；但同样重要的是，要确保当参与石油销售的不可持续企业停止运营时，这些企业的员工能在转岗中获得帮助。

例句.英文: Wang and colleagues excluded all pathways other than the CMN by using barriers to keep the plants’ root systems separate while allowing mycorrhizal strands through—an essential step He and colleagues’ study did not take. Text 2Wang and colleagues took the necessary precaution of separating the plants’ root systems (thereby excluding root-to-root transmission).
例句.中文: Wang 及同事用屏障隔开各株植物的根系、只放行菌根菌丝，从而排除了菌根网络之外的一切路径——这是 He 等人的研究未采取的关键步骤。——Wang 等人采取了必要预防措施：分离植物根系（从而排除根间直接传导）。

义项: 名词 日常饮食中不可或缺的基本食物（a staple in their diet 他们饮食中的主食）
形容词 (引申义) 主要的、基本的（staple crops 主要作物）

例句.英文: Kwakwaka'wakw song keeper Kwaxsistalla Wathl'thla aided research by ethnobiologist Dana Lepofsky et al. by contributing songs that reference creating terraced intertidal gardens to foster the healthy development of clams, a staple in the Kwakwaka'wakw people's diet.
例句.原书高亮: a staple in the Kwakwaka'wakw people's diet
例句.中文: 夸夸嘉夸族的歌者 Kwaxsistalla Wathl'thla 为民族生物学家 Dana Lepofsky 等人的研究提供了帮助，贡献了提到修建潮间带梯田式园圃、以促进蛤蜊健康生长的歌曲——蛤蜊是该族饮食中的主食。

例句.英文: Signs of his incompetence were evident on his front door: the nameplate hung crookedly, and the hasp didn’t quite meet its staple.
例句.中文: 他不称职的迹象在自家前门就可见一斑：铭牌挂歪了，搭扣与扣鼻也没对齐。

义项: 名词 水果压榨后的浆状物（acerola pulp 针叶樱桃果浆）
名词 (引申义) 纸浆；（通俗低劣的）庸俗作品 pulp fiction

例句.英文: Recent advancements in ohmic heating were made through research in Brazil on the preservation of acerola pulp.
例句.中文: 欧姆加热技术近来的进展，来自巴西关于针叶樱桃果浆保存的研究。

义项: 形容词 能长期保存、不易损坏的（durable historical artifacts 耐久的历史器物）
[辨析] 与 lasting 近义；durable goods 耐用品

例句.英文: She ties this hypothesis to the high value the sea snails would have had for the Calusa, both nutritionally and as a building material (conch shells are highly durable).
例句.中文: 她把这一假说与海螺对卡卢萨人（Calusa）的高价值联系起来——既作为食物，也作为建筑材料（海螺壳非常耐用）。

例句.英文: Being coarser than Merino wool overall, Navajo-Churro wool yields a more durable yarn, which Diné (Navajo) weavers use in their celebrated rugs.
例句.中文: 纳瓦霍-丘罗羊毛整体比美利奴羊毛粗，纺出的纱线更耐用，迪内（纳瓦霍）织工正是用它织出著名的地毯。

义项: 名词 economy 的复数在此不指「多种经济」，而指「多个经济体（国家 / 地区）」——emerging economies 新兴经济体，即快速增长的发展中市场（真题语境：外汇储备变动研究）
[辨析] economic 经济上的（adj.）≠ economical 节约的（adj.）；economy 单数 = 经济 / 节约（economy of scale 规模经济）
搭配说明: emerging — 现在分词作定语 · 新兴的、正在崛起的（emerging technologies / emerging field 真题亦现）
economy → economies — 复数义变考点：国家经济体系（economies of East Asia）；「节约」义则不可数

例句.英文: Investigating whether herding also occurs among nations in matters of economic policy, Maru Etta-Nkwelle examined changes in the foreign currency reserves of emerging economies in various world regions in the years following the widespread financial crisis of 1997.
例句.中文: 为考察羊群效应是否也发生在各国的经济政策层面，Maru Etta-Nkwelle 研究了 1997 年金融危机全面爆发后数年间，世界各地区新兴经济体（emerging economies）的外汇储备变动。

义项: 形容词 结构严密、论证严格的（a more rigorous structure 更严谨的结构）
[辨析] 褒义；名词 rigor 严格、严酷

例句.英文: Economist Thomas Piketty’s book Capital in the Twenty-First Century has a more rigorous structure than its sequel, Capital and Ideology.
例句.中文: 经济学家托马斯·皮凯蒂的《二十一世纪资本论》结构比其续作《资本与意识形态》更为严谨。

义项: 名词 生物或行为上的可辨识特点（a male trait 雄性特征）
[辨析] 遗传学、心理学常用；与 characteristic 近义但更偏「可遗传、可测量」

例句.英文: They claim that the historical mischaracterization of birdsong as a male trait is largely the result of bias: much of the research ornithologists have carried out has been near universities in the temperate northern hemisphere, where female birdsong is less common than it is in the tropics.
例句.中文: 他们主张，把鸟鸣历史性地误认为雄性特征，很大程度上是偏见的产物：鸟类学家开展的许多研究都在北半球温带的大学附近进行，而那里的雌鸟鸣叫远不如热带常见。

例句.英文: Researchers conducted a meta-analysis of studies of how such noise affects animals and found that, for every study, relevant traits or behaviors of the animals were observably different between the exposed group and the otherwise similar but unexposed group.
例句.中文: 研究者对「此类噪声如何影响动物」的研究做了一项元分析，发现每项研究中暴露组与条件相似但未暴露的对照组相比，动物的相关性状或行为都存在可观察的差异。

义项: 形容词 外来物种扩散并造成危害的（invasive species 入侵物种）
形容词 (引申义) 侵入性的（invasive surgery 微创/侵入性手术）

例句.英文: However, like many highly specialized species, the kiwikiu is particularly vulnerable to environmental stressors, such as disease, invasive species, and habitat destruction, that disrupt the delicately balanced ecosystems in which the birds live.
例句.中文: 然而，像许多高度特化的物种一样，kiwikiu 特别容易受到环境压力的冲击，例如疾病、入侵物种与栖息地破坏——这些都会扰乱鸟类所赖以生存的精细平衡的生态系统。

例句.英文: But researchers Alejandro Camacho and Jason Mc Lachlan have pointed out that "invasive" and "native" are labels that describe temporary circumstances.
例句.中文: 但研究者 Alejandro Camacho 与 Jason Mc Lachlan 指出：「入侵」与「本土」只是描述暂时状态的标签。

义项: 名词 力求如实再现现实的创作方法（magical realism 魔幻现实主义）
[辨析] 与 romanticism（浪漫主义）相对；magical realism 是拉美文学标志性流派

例句.英文: Scholars cite The Kingdom of This World, the 1949 novel by Cuban author Alejo Carpentier, as a foundational test of magical realism, the Lation American style of fiction in which antirealistic plot devices—often borrowed from the folkloric traditions of Indigenous and colonial societies in the Americas—are deployed in an otherwise realistic mode of representation typical of the modern novel.
例句.中文: 学者们把古巴作家阿莱霍·卡彭铁尔 1949 年的小说《这个世界的王国》视为魔幻现实主义的奠基性试验——这一拉美小说风格在原本属于现代小说典型的写实再现模式中，嵌入了反现实的叙事手法（多借自美洲原住民与殖民社会的民间传说传统）。

例句.英文: This style has exerted a decisive influence on authors around the world, including Orhan Pamuk, whose 2001 novel My Name ls Red resembles classic magical realist novels in its juxtaposition of literary realism with folklore namely, that of Turkey.
例句.中文: 这一风格对世界各地的作家都产生了决定性影响，其中包括奥尔罕·帕慕克——他 2001 年的《我的名字叫红》把文学现实主义与民间传说（即土耳其的民俗）并置，酷似经典的魔幻现实主义小说。

义项: 名词 用作比较基准的初始数值（pretraining baselines 训练前的基线）
名词 (引申义) （项目的）基准线；baseline data 基线数据

例句.英文: Persad and her colleagues concluded that concentration of precipitation into fewer events would result in a higher number of dry days, triggering more irrigation, but that this change in irrigation output is highly sensitive to the baseline concentration of precipitation that currently exists in an area.
例句.中文: 这一研究文献受困于假设不清、样本量不足、缺少对照组，以及未能为所测的参与者属性建立训练前的基线。

例句.英文: This research literature is plagued by unclear hypotheses, insufficient sample sizes, a lack of control groups, and failures to establish pretraining baselines for the measured attributes of participants.

义项: 名词 按时间顺序记述的历史（a three-volume chronicle 三卷本编年史）
动词 (引申义) 记录、记述（chronicle the decline 记录衰落过程）

例句.英文: Edmund Morris, noted for his three-volume chronicle of the life of Theodore Roosevelt, completed Edison, his biography of Thomas Edison, in 2019.
例句.中文: 以三卷本西奥多·罗斯福传记闻名的埃德蒙·莫里斯，于 2019 年完成了他那部托马斯·爱迪生传记《Edison》。

例句.英文: Siemowit appears in the Gesta principum Polonorum, a chronicle of medieval Polish history written between 1112 and 1118.
例句.中文: 谢莫维特见于《波兰君公事迹》——一部写于 1112 至 1118 年间的中世纪波兰编年史。

义项: 动词 使裂开、破碎（the lithosphere is fractured into plates 岩石圈断裂成板块）
名词 (引申义) 骨折；（社会）分裂；形容词 fractured

例句.英文: Researchers investigated the timing of the transition from a stagnant lid regime to a tectonic plate regime, in which the lithosphere is fractured into dynamic plates that in turn allow lithospheric and mantle material to mix.
例句.中文: 研究者考察了从「停滞盖层」体制向「板块构造」体制转变的时间——在后者中，岩石圈断裂成动态的板块，从而使岩石圈物质与地幔物质得以混合。

例句.英文: HEAs and MEAs are known for withstanding cracking at extremely low (cryogenic) temperatures relatively well, though their fracture toughness generally falls as temperature does.
例句.中文: 高熵合金与中熵合金以在极低（低温）温度下相对不易开裂著称，尽管其断裂韧性通常随温度下降而降低。

义项: 形容词 被关在人工环境中的（captive chimpanzees 圈养的黑猩猩）
名词 (引申义) 俘虏；captive audience 不得不听/看的受众

例句.英文: Among studies of nonhuman primates, James Welles's 1976 study of captive chimpanzees and catarrhine monkeys reported more right-handed individuals than left-handed ones, but William C.
例句.中文: 在非人灵长类研究中，James Welles 1976 年对圈养黑猩猩与狭鼻猴的研究报告称，右利手的个体多于左利手，但 William C.……

义项: 名词 基层司法官员（judges or magistrates 法官或治安官）
[辨析] 英国指基层治安法官，美国指较低审级的司法官员

例句.英文: A report from an international organization that monitors the numbers of women serving as judges or magistrates on various nations’ highest courts, such as the Supreme court in Finland and the Supreme Court in the Dominican republic.
例句.中文: 一份来自某国际组织的报告，监测了各国最高法院（如芬兰最高法院与多米尼加共和国最高法院）中担任法官或地方法官的女性人数。

例句.英文: For instance, the number of women judges and magistrates on high courts in ______

义项: 名词 发展过程中的重大节点（the album Milestones 专辑《Milestones》）
名词 路边的里程标石；引申为「标志性事件」

例句.英文: Known for the albums Someday My Prince Will Come and Milestones, jazz trumpeter Miles Davis collaborated several times with pianist Gil Evans.
例句.中文: 爵士小号手迈尔斯·戴维斯以《Someday My Prince Will Come》与《Milestones》等专辑闻名，曾多次与钢琴家 Gil Evans 合作。

义项: 名词 拥有地方自治权的行政区（the Puerto Rican municipality of Hatillo 波多黎各的阿蒂约市）
[构词] municipal 市政的 → municipality；municipal government 市政府

例句.英文: Huazalingo is a municipality in the state of Hidalgo, Mexico.
例句.中文: 例如，波多黎各的阿蒂约市也被称为「绿野之地」，这个别称点出了该地区的著名之处：环绕四周的葱郁草木。

例句.英文: In 2015, geologist Peter Rogerson calculated that the geographic center of Oklahoma was a point 4.4 miles south of the municipality of Edmond.
例句.中文: 2015 年，地质学家 Peter Rogerson 计算出俄克拉何马州的地理中心位于埃德蒙市以南 4.4 英里处。

义项: 形容词 未经指令、自然发生的（spontaneous laughs 自发的笑）
[辨析] 与 volitional（有意的）对照；名词 spontaneity 自发性

例句.英文: Study participants from 21 societies, including those in Austria and Turkey, listened to randomized recordings of 18 spontaneous laughs taken from natural conversations between pairs of women and 18 volitional laughs produced separately by 18 different women in response to an experimenter's instruction to laugh.
例句.中文: 来自 21 个社会（包括奥地利与土耳其）的研究参与者，听了一批随机排序的录音：18 段取自两名女性自然对话中的自发笑声，以及另外 18 名女性按实验者指令发出的有意笑声。

例句.英文: When classical pianist Martha Argerich performs, it appears as if the music is coming to her spontaneously.
例句.中文: 古典钢琴家玛塔·阿格里奇演奏时，音乐仿佛是自她心中即兴涌现。

义项: 名词 阻碍顺畅进行的阻力（cognitive friction 认知摩擦）
名词 (引申义) 人际、组织间的摩擦；动词 frictional

例句.英文: One reason is that exact prices may create greater cognitive friction during purchase decisions than do whole-number prices or prices easily rounded to whole numbers (e.g., $5.99, which is little different from $6).
例句.中文: 原因之一是：与整数价格或易于取整的价格（例如 5.99 美元，与 6 美元相差无几）相比，精确价格在购买决策中可能带来更大的认知摩擦。

例句.英文: Using carbon nanotubes and oil, Jun Qu and colleagues at a US Department of Energy lab have created a coating for moving parts that reduces friction to the point where it is almost nonexistent.
例句.中文: Jun Qu 及其美国能源部实验室的同事利用碳纳米管和油，为运动部件研制出一种涂层，把摩擦减低到几乎不复存在。

义项: 名词 树木或植物的全部叶子（the foliage of the oaks 橡树的叶丛）
名词 foliage gleaning 叶面拾取：鸟类从叶面啄食昆虫的觅食方式

例句.英文: Conversely, Myrmotherula guttata (the rufous-bellied antwren), with which M. fusca shares territory in French Guiana, practices foliage gleaning (picking insects off leaves), substantially limiting the bird’s field of vision while foraging.
例句.中文: 相反，Myrmotherula guttata（红腹蚁鸟）——在法属圭亚那与 M. fusca 共享领地——采用「叶面拾取」（从叶片上啄食昆虫）的方式觅食，这大大限制了该鸟觅食时的视野。

例句.英文: The wood I walk in on this mild May day, with the young yellow-brown foliage of the oaks between me and the blue sky, the white star-flowers and the blue-eyed speedwell and the ground ivy at my feet, is one of those happy spots where the soul may sit and hold silent converse with itself.

义项: 形容词 写在页面空白处的（marginal notes 页边批注）
形容词 (引申义) 边缘的、微小的（marginal change 微小变化）

例句.英文: In some domestic breeds, such as the Spanish Merino, the outer fiber is only marginally coarser than the inner, and the wool is soft overall.
例句.中文: 在一些家养品种中，例如西班牙美利奴羊，外层纤维只比内层略粗一些，羊毛整体柔软。

例句.英文: Support for the argument that a " onsumer rewohlutiom, in which possession ofconsumer goods among an increasingly wide range ofsociceconomic goups surged despite only marginal wage growith, oecurred in Engand between 1600 and 1750has largely hinged on scholars analyses of peobate inventorles (detalled legal records ofdeceased persons' possesions).
例句.中文: 「1600 至 1750 年间英格兰发生过一场『消费革命』——工资仅微涨而拥有消费品的社会群体却大为拓宽」这一论点的支持，主要系于学者对遗嘱财产清单（对逝者财产的详细法律记录）的分析。

义项: 名词 货币面值超过其生产成本所产生的利润（positive seigniorage 正铸币税）
名词 经济学专门术语：政府凭铸币权获得的收入，SAT 经济类文章偶见

例句.英文: … Issuing a one-dollar coin yields positive seigniorage—profit generated when the face value of a coin exceeds the unit cost of producing it …
例句.中文: 发行一美元硬币可产生正铸币税——即硬币面值超过其单位生产成本所产生的利润——供新加坡政府用于交通等公共服务。

义项: 名词 某事开始发生的时点（the epoch's onset 该世元的起始）
[辨析] 常指疾病、季节、时期的「发作、来临」；与 outset 近义

例句.英文: Some geologists have proposed designating the period from 1950 to the present as a new geological epoch (the Anthropocene) characterized by human impact on Earth, but they have struggled to identify reliable stratigraphic markers of the epoch’s onset.
例句.中文: 一些地质学家提议把 1950 年至今定为一个新的地质世元（人类世），以人类对地球的影响为特征，但他们一直难以找到该世元起始的可靠地层标志。

例句.英文: Researchers tested the hypothesis by examining a population of broadleaf arrowhead, a plant for which bloom onset generally takes longer for male flowers than for female flowers, during the flowering season.
例句.中文: 研究者通过考察一个阔叶慈姑种群来检验该假说——这种植物的雄花通常比雌花更晚开花。

义项: 形容词 在现实条件下做得到的（might be feasible 也许可行）
[辨析] 与 possible 不同：feasible 强调「资源、条件下可实现」

例句.英文: While rebuilding an HZ’s physical structure (e.g., with gravel) might be feasible, is it possible to restore its biological community?
例句.中文: 重建一个 HZ 的物理结构（例如用砾石）也许可行，但能否恢复其生物群落呢？

例句.英文: Assuming a scenario in which 10% coverage of currently eligible land by such infrastructure is feasible …
例句.中文: 假设目前可用土地中 10% 用于此类基础设施是可行的……

义项: 名词 体会他人感受的能力（greater patient empathy 更强的患者共情）
[辨析] 与 sympathy（同情）不同：empathy 是「设身处地」，sympathy 是「为之难过」

例句.英文: There is a growing belief that teaching medical students about art alongside standard science and clinical coursework helps them become more observant, develop greater patient empathy, and strengthen their communication skills.
例句.中文: 越来越多的人相信，在标准理科与临床课程之外，同时教医学生艺术，有助于他们变得更善于观察、培养更强的患者共情，并增强沟通能力。

义项: 名词 与韵文相对的书面表达（the prose in his novel 他小说中的散文笔法）
[辨析] prose poem 散文诗；prosaic 平淡乏味的

例句.英文: For example, it is true that the prose in his novel Foundation is quite plain—we are often given only the faintest ideas of what people, objects, and settings look like.
例句.中文: 例如，他小说《基地》中的散文笔法确实相当平实——我们往往只能得到关于人物、物体与场景的最模糊的印象。

例句.英文: His prose is workmanlike: his characters are flat and discuss ideas rather than emotions.
例句.中文: 他的文笔只是工匠水平：人物扁平，谈的是观念而非情感。

义项: 名词 供研究用的生物或矿物样本（specimens of Pacific herring 太平洋鲱鱼标本）
[辨析] 医学语境指「化验样本」；与 sample 相比更强调「个体样本」

例句.英文: To measure changes in parasite abundance over time, Chelsea Wood and colleagues counted parasite individuals preserved on specimens of Pacific herring, spotted ratfish, and six other fish species collected from Puget Sound between 1880 and 2019.
例句.中文: 为测量寄生虫丰度随时间的变化，Chelsea Wood 及同事清点了保存在太平洋鲱、斑点鼠鱼等八种鱼类标本上的寄生虫个体——这些标本于 1880 至 2019 年间采自普吉特湾。

例句.英文: Michael G. Campana and colleagues relied on historical DNA (hDNA)—genomic data incidentally preserved in specimens housed in natural history collections—to investigate the evolutionary origins of a fungal pathogen affecting bats.
例句.中文: Michael G. Campana 及同事依赖历史 DNA——偶然保存于自然史馆藏标本中的基因组数据——来研究一种侵害蝙蝠的真菌病原体的演化起源。

义项: 名词 协同演出的艺术团体（the Negro Ensemble Company 黑人剧团）
名词 (引申义) 整套、整体（an ensemble cast 群像阵容）；音乐指「合奏」

例句.英文: Steve Carter’s award-winning play Eden was produced in 1976 by the groundbreaking Negro Ensemble Company (NEC).
例句.中文: Steve Carter 的获奖剧作《伊甸园》（Eden）于 1976 年由具有开创意义的黑人剧团（Negro Ensemble Company，NEC）制作。

例句.英文: Steiger Butte Drum, a family ensemble from the Klamath Tribes of the Pacific Northwest, collaborated with composer Michael Gordon to create Natural History, a work featuring traditional drumming and vocals alongside an orchestra and chorus.
例句.中文: 来自西北太平洋克拉马斯部落的家族鼓乐团 Steiger Butte Drum 与作曲家 Michael Gordon 合作创作了《自然史》——一部以传统鼓乐与人声，联袂管弦乐团与合唱团的作品。

义项: 名词 用以间接代表另一事物的量（proxy indicators 替代性指标）
名词 (引申义) 代理人、委托书；by proxy 通过代理

例句.英文: To better understand consumer loyalty to specific online retailers, Peter Štarchon and colleagues created a survey using 58 statements as proxy indicators of customer experience with receiving goods purchased online.
例句.中文: 为更好地理解消费者对特定网络零售商的忠诚度，Peter Štarchon 及同事设计了一份问卷，用 58 项陈述作为衡量顾客网购收货体验的替代性指标。

例句.英文: Melissa Toups et al. proposed a novel proxy: the evolution of the clothing-exclusive variant of the human-exclusive parasite Pediculus humanus (head lice), which Toups et al. date to as early as 170 Ka.
例句.中文: Melissa Toups 等人提出了一个新颖的替代指标：人类专有寄生虫（头虱）之「衣物专有变种」的演化——Toups 等人将其年代定至最早 17 万年前。

义项: 名词 以彼物喻此物的修辞（metaphors and other poetic devices 隐喻及其它诗歌手法）
[辨析] 与 simile（明喻，用 like/as）不同：metaphor 是直接替换

例句.英文: Wole Soyinka’s prose poem “Chimes of Silence” challenges the notion that prose poetry—a hybrid form that blends prose formatting with metaphors and other traditional poetic devices—ought to be contained within a single page.
例句.原书高亮: metaphors and other traditional poetic devices
例句.中文: 沃莱·索因卡的散文诗《寂静的钟声》挑战了这样一种观念：散文诗——一种把散文排版与隐喻等传统诗歌手法相融合的混合形式——应当被限制在一页之内。

例句.英文: Poetry in Classical Nahuatl, the language of the Aztec Empire, relies on difrasismo, or a parallel noun construction that conventionally operates as a single metaphor.
例句.中文: 古典纳瓦特尔语（阿兹特克帝国的语言）诗歌依赖 difrasismo——一种习惯上作为单一隐喻运作的平行名词结构。

义项: 名词 出资支持艺术家、团体的人（the role of patron 赞助人的角色）
[辨析] 与 customer（顾客）不同：patron 含「庇护、扶持」意味；patronize 光顾/居高临下

例句.英文: Whether resigned or not to the verdict of the public, he ceased to write plays and assumed instead the nobler role of patron to unrecognized authors and artists and to ruined managers.
例句.中文: 无论他是否接受了公众的裁决，他都不再写剧本，转而承担起更崇高的角色：为未获赏识的作家、艺术家以及破产的剧团经理充当赞助人。

义项: 形容词 以数量数据为基础的分析（a quantitative analysis 定量分析）
[辨析] 与 qualitative（定性的）相对；quantity → quantitative

例句.英文: Focusing on two characteristics that are positive indices of grammatical complexity, fusion (when new phonemes arise from the merger of previously distinct ones) and informativity (languages' capacity for meaningful variation), Olena Shcherbakova and colleagues conducted a quantitative analysis for more than 1,300 languages and claim the outcome is inconsistent with the LNH.
例句.中文: Olena Shcherbakova 及同事聚焦于两项标志语法复杂度的正向指标——融合（新音素由原本相异的音素合并而生）与信息性（语言产生有意义变体的能力）——对 1300 多种语言做了定量分析，并声称结果与语言生态位假说不符。

例句.英文: Meanwhile, Elizabeth von Armin's The Enchanted April, whose coherent, linear narrative structure recalls the fiction of previous centuries, attracts woefully little attention from scholars of modernism.Text 2Distant reading, or computer-assisted quantitative analysis of massive collections of digitized texts, can reveal stylistic elements that have heretofore escaped notice, despite being shared by numerous texts from the modernist period.
例句.中文: 与此同时，伊丽莎白·冯·阿尼姆的《魔幻四月》——其连贯的线性叙事结构令人想起前几个世纪的小说——却几乎得不到现代主义学者的关注。——远读，即对海量数字化文本的计算机辅助定量分析，能够揭示此前无人察觉的风格要素，尽管这些要素为现代主义时期的众多文本所共有。

义项: 形容词 独自生活、不成群的（from the solitary to the social 从独居到群居）
[辨析] 与 lonely（寂寞的）不同：solitary 是客观状态，不含情绪

例句.英文: The scenario of a dwarf mongoose engaging in territorial conflict with an outgroup dwarf mongoose illustrates a major dimension of social life across animal species, from the solitary to those with complex sociality: intraspecific contact with perceived outsiders.
例句.原书高亮: from the solitary to those with complex sociality
例句.中文: 一只侏儒獴与外来侏儒獴发生领地冲突的情景，例示了动物物种社会生活的一个重要维度：从独居到高度群居，都存在与被视为外来者的同类接触。

例句.英文: The narrator indicates that her aunt and uncle’s home in Kansas is remote and solitary, writing that ______

义项: 形容词 唯一一次、不重复的（the singular nature 单一性）
[辨析] 与 single 不同：singular 强调「独一无二、罕见」；语法中指单数

例句.英文: Accounts of American revolutionary history often imply that the US Declaration of Independence (published in 1776) was a document that specifically resulted from the presumably exceptional nature of the soon‑to‑be United States—in this interpretation, the Declaration is a singular instrument born from a response to injustice that was intended to announce the birth of a new kind of nation and win foreign allies to that nation’s cause.
例句.中文: 关于美国革命史的叙述常常暗示，1776 年发表的《美国独立宣言》是一项独特的文献，专门诞生于即将成形的美国那想必不同寻常的特质——按此解读，《宣言》是为回应不义而诞生的独特文书，旨在宣告一个新型国家的诞生，并为这个国家的事业赢得外国盟友。

例句.英文: By focusing on singular individuals and incidents in exhaustive detail, Paul Seaver’s Wellington’s World and other microhistories aim to show how broader phenomena were experienced at a human level.
例句.中文: 通过穷尽式地聚焦个别个体与事件，Paul Seaver 的《威灵顿的世界》等微观史力求展示宏大现象在人的尺度上是如何被经历的。
